subtopic: Nature of Geography as a Discipline
stem: Make a list of the skills that are obtained through the study of Geography. Some are given here as a hint (fig. 8.1, Skills of a Geographer): observation; data collection using surveys, photographs and satellite images; land surveying with the help of instruments and advanced technology; data organisation; data interpretation; data representation with the help of graphs and maps; making maps; analysis with the help of statistical techniques; writing reports and presenting the findings.

subtopic: Scope of Geography and Its Links with Other Subjects
stem:
Given here are some of the concepts or subject matter studied in Geography. Write the name of the subject or discipline you think each is also studied in. One has been done for you as an example.

Table 8.2

| Concepts | Subject in which the concept is also studied |
|---|---|
| Calculations involved in projections, shapes of projections | ......... |
| Means of livelihood : agriculture, industry, trade, etc. | Economics |
| Cost of production, GDP, incomes, resources, scarcity, etc. | ......... |
| Social relations and inequalities | ......... |
| Racial structure of humans, evolution of humans, etc. | ......... |
| Rocks and minerals | ......... |
| Behaviour of humans in different climates and topography | ......... |
| Electoral divisions, voting patterns, types of governments | ......... |
| Biomes, food chain, forests, etc. | ......... |
| Chemical weathering, erosion, acid rain, etc. | ......... |
| Mean, variance, correlation, regression, etc. | ......... |
| Past of different places, their development before attaining the present day status, etc. | ......... |

subtopic: Latest Trends and Careers in Geography
stem:
A newspaper item listing job opportunities is given below (fig. 8.5, Sample Advertisement). Go through all the entries and say which ones are suitable for a geographer as a career.

1. Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) - Class-1 Officer 2020 (Notice for Interviews), National Atlas of Thematic Mapping organisation of India, Deputy Director General (Map). Vacant Seats: 2 (1 for UR, 1 Reserved). Educational Qualifications: M.A./M.Sc. Geography, Cartographer, Masters in Urban Planning. Experience: Minimum 5 years.

2. Mumbai Mahanagar Palika, Department of Urban Planning, Mumbai. Post: Urban planner, Class-1 (open). Place of work: Mumbai. Qualification: MA Geography / M.Arch. / M.Planning. Experience: 5 years in urban planning or similar work.

3. Assistant professor. Subjects: Geology, Geography, History, Rural Development. Posts: 4 (2 UR, 2 Reserved). Educational Qualifications: Graduation and Post Graduation in the subjects mentioned above, NET/SET compulsory. Desirable: M.Phil. / PhD.

4. UN internship - Required consultant to support UNCT Gender Equality Marker implementation. Location: New York. Language: English and French. Starting date: 16th Mar 2021. Initial Contract Period: 10 months. Educational Qualifications: Masters Degree in Development Studies / Gender Studies / Social Sciences.

5. UPSC Engineering Services Examination (Exam notice 2021) (IES). Eligibility: Any Engineering graduate. Total Posts: 495.

6. Bank PO exam. Eligibility: Any graduate. Total Posts: 50.

7. UPSC Combined Defence Services (CDS). Eligibility: Any graduate. Total Posts: 123.
